name: Rescue–Dependency Loop

topology.cycle: deficit -> rescue -> reduced autonomous action -> increased need for rescue

activation: one actor repeatedly substitutes for another actor's function
substitution reduces pressure or opportunity for autonomous action
maintenance: short-term relief strengthens the same rescue route
signatures: help increasingly becomes required for baseline functioning
withdrawal of help is treated as creation of the deficit rather than exposure of it
falsePositives: temporary assistance with a clear handoff
care where autonomy is impossible or irrelevant

breakpoints.operation: make responsibility and handoff rules explicit
